snippet.title: KARANEKO - Official Gameplay Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
BACK US ON KICKSTARTER! Coming November 4th!
Make sure you follow and tap the link to receive notifications the moment our campaign starts!
Link: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nekoda/karaneko

Play KARANEKO Demo on STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3102220/KARANEKO

Join our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/karaneko
Follow us on X: https://x.com/KARANEKO_Game

Karaneko is a 2D pixel-art bullet hell JRPG where you search for your lost brother. Build relationships with NPCs, survive deadly streets, or step into the academy’s world of puzzles and mysteries to uncover dark secrets. The choice is yours~

Original Soundtrack "Black Vox " by vIIIv
Black Vox MV by vIIIv: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5y-W9jIu3s4
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@v.III.v/videos
X: https://x.com/nanasi_o_0_

Animation created by Colza & Pauline
Colza: https://linktr.ee/colza.mp4
Pauline:  https://www.instagram.com/missjewelbox
